projects.name: AeroLens
projects.tagline: Modular Drone Flight Log Analytics, Spectral Anomaly Detection & Reporting Platform
projects.problem_statement: Raw ArduPilot (.bin), PX4 (.ulg), and MAVLink flight logs encapsulate multi-rate IMU, ESC, GPS, and battery messages where transient rotor harmonics, voltage sags, and sensor glitches are tedious to isolate manually across post-flight debriefs.
projects.solution_summary: **AeroLens (`aerolens-flight-analytics`)** is a production-grade post-flight UAV telemetry analysis platform. It ingests multi-ecosystem drone flight logs (**ArduPilot**, **PX4 ULog**, **MAVLink**), executes physics-based and statistical anomaly detection (electro-chemical battery $R_{\text{int}}$, SciPy FFT vibration ...
key_highlights: Multi-format ArduPilot/PX4 ULog & MAVLink log ingestion
Spectral FFT harmonic peak, voltage brownout & GPS HDOP anomaly engine
SQLite flight history persistence with FastAPI REST API
Automated PDF, interactive HTML & CSV flight diagnostics export

architecture.summary: Multi-stage telemetry ingestion, signal spectral diagnostics, persistent storage, and interactive reporting pipeline.

nodes.label: SQLite + SQLAlchemy Store

nodes.detail: Serves JSON time-series and exports PDF, HTML, and CSV mission briefs.

nodes.label: React + TS + Plotly HUD
nodes.detail: Interactive synchronized flight waveforms, anomaly pins & FFT overlays.

hardware.summary: Pure software flight log analytics suite; ingests real Pixhawk / ArduPilot / PX4 hardware logs.

projects.name: SARVision
projects.tagline: AI-Powered Aerial Search & Rescue Tiled Vision, Geolocation & Verification System
projects.problem_statement: High-resolution UAV nadir/oblique imagery renders stranded hikers or distress markers as sub-32px targets that disappear under whole-image resizing, while uncalibrated pixel boxes lack verified latitude/longitude coordinates for ground rescue dispatch.
projects.solution_summary: **Offline-capable, Dual-Stage Computer Vision & Geospatial Intelligence System for Aerial Search & Rescue (SAR)**
key_highlights: Overlapping high-res aerial tiler + global cross-tile NMS deduplication
ONNX Runtime / PyTorch + OpenCV spectral contrast SAR target detector
EXIF metadata pinhole camera model projecting pixel boxes to GPS lat/lon
Precision/Recall/IoU evaluator + operator verification workflow UI

architecture.summary: Tiled inference pipeline preserving small-object resolution with photogrammetric GPS raycasting and human verification.

nodes.detail: Slices 4K/8K orthophotos into overlapping inference patches with margin guards.

nodes.detail: Detects high-contrast distress gear, thermal/spectral signatures & persons.

nodes.detail: Merges duplicate detections across overlapping tile borders in frame coordinates.

nodes.detail: Scores synthetic validation sets and stages detections for operator confirmation.

nodes.label: React + TS Inspector UI
nodes.detail: Visualizes tiled detections, confidence thresholds & exported GPS waypoints.

hardware.summary: AI computer vision software platform calibrated for UAV RGB/thermal camera EXIF intrinsics.

projects.name: FlightCore
projects.tagline: Modular ESP32 Drone Sensor Suite & CRC-16 LoRa Telemetry System (KiCad + PlatformIO)
projects.problem_statement: Custom research multi-rotors need a lightweight, EMI-resilient telemetry avionics board capable of fusing IMU attitude, laser altitude, rotor RPM, and pack health into CRC-16 protected LoRa packets independent of main flight controller lockups.
projects.solution_summary: **STRICT SAFETY CONSTRAINT**: FlightCore is **exclusively a passive sensor acquisition and LoRa telemetry expansion module**. It contains **NO motor/ESC PWM control, NO servo actuation, and NO flight controller stabilization loops**.
key_highlights: Deterministic ESP32 PlatformIO C++ firmware with modular sensor drivers
Custom binary LoRa packet framing with CRC-16 integrity verification
KiCad 8 schematic, 2/4-layer PCB layout, manufacturing Gerbers & BOM
Automated C++/Python packet & sensor calibration verification suite

architecture.summary: Real-time ESP32 sensor acquisition fused into CRC-16 LoRa telemetry frames on a custom KiCad avionics carrier PCB.

projects.name: CellGuard

projects.solution_summary: **CellGuard** (`cellguard-battery-monitor`) is an end-to-end embedded + hardware + analytics platform for monitoring **1S–6S 21700 Li-Ion battery packs** (optimized for **4S 14.8 V** and **6S 22.2 V** packs). It combines a KiCad 8 Kelvin-shunt instrumentation PCB, modular ESP32 PlatformIO C++ firmware, a BenchTwin digi...
